items.title_en: Improving Scene Graph Generation with Root-Cause Analysis
summary_en: Scene graph generation (SGG) involves identifying objects in images and their relationships. Current methods show performance drops but not specific failure points. RoHa-SGG uses root-cause analysis to optimize models without retraining.
RoHa-SGG introduces two LLM agents to identify failure components and optimize inference code around frozen models, improving SGG accuracy.
key_points_en: Existing SGG methods don't identify where models fail
RoHa-SGG uses root-cause analysis agents
Optimizes inference code without retraining models
translation_zh: 场景图生成（SGG）涉及识别图像中的物体及其关系。当前方法显示性能下降但无法定位具体失败点。RoHa-SGG通过根本原因分析优化模型而无需重新训练。
RoHa-SGG引入两个LLM代理来识别失败组件并优化冻结模型的推理代码，提高SGG准确性。

items.title_en: LesionAgent: AI Tool for Tracking Tumors Without Training
summary_en: Cancer patients get CT scans every few months to check treatment progress. Current AI models can analyze scans but don't interpret them like radiologists.
LesionAgent is a new AI system that reads scans end-to-end without special training, following medical rules to track tumors over time
key_points_en: Uses 3D models without needing task-specific training
Tracks lesions across multiple CT scans
Follows clinical guidelines for tumor assessment
translation_zh: 癌症患者每隔几个月会进行CT扫描以检查治疗进展。目前的AI模型可以分析扫描结果，但无法像放射科医生一样进行解读。
LesionAgent是一种新的AI系统，无需特殊训练即可端到端地阅读扫描结果，并遵循医学规则跟踪肿瘤变化

items.title_en: AgentArk: Combining Multi-Agent Intelligence into One LLM
summary_en: Multi-agent systems improve reasoning but face high costs and errors. AgentArk reduces these issues by distilling multi-agent interactions into a single model.
This method keeps the intelligence of multiple agents while using less computation.
The framework tests three distillation strategies across different models and tasks.
key_points_en: Multi-agent systems have high computational costs and error risks
AgentArk distills interactions into a single model
The approach maintains efficiency and multi-agent intelligence
translation_zh: 多智能体系统虽然能提升推理能力，但存在高成本和错误风险。AgentArk通过将多智能体交互压缩到单一模型中来减少这些问题
该方法在保持计算效率的同时保留了多智能体的智能
框架在不同模型和任务中测试了三种蒸馏策略

items.title_en: Nvidia's Stock Surge: What Investors Should Do Next in the AI Trade
summary_en: Nvidia's stock has risen sharply following CEO Jensen Huang's return, but investors and lawmakers are cautious about the AI trade's future.
Experts suggest careful evaluation of risks and opportunities in the current market climate.
key_points_en: Nvidia's stock has surged after CEO Jensen Huang's return.
Investors and lawmakers are cautious about the AI trade's future.
Market experts advise evaluating risks and opportunities carefully.
translation_zh: Nvidia的股价在CEO黄仁勋回归后大幅上涨，但投资者和立法者对人工智能交易的未来持谨慎态度。
专家建议在当前市场环境下仔细评估风险和机遇。

items.title_en: Nvidia CEO's Return Boosts Asian Partner Stocks
summary_en: Investors are increasing their investments in technology companies following the reinstatement of Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang.
This move has led to a rise in stock prices for Nvidia's partners and suppliers in Asia.
key_points_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was reinstated by the board.
Investor confidence in tech markets has increased.
Asian partner stocks rose following the news.
translation_zh: 投资者在Nvidia首席执行官Jensen Huang被董事会重新任命后，增加了对科技公司的投资。
此举导致亚洲合作伙伴的股票价格上涨。

items.title_en: Fed official suggests higher rates may be needed to control inflation
summary_en: Fed's John Williams believes inflation will approach the 2% target by 2027.
Higher interest rates are likely over time to manage inflation.
The Fed aims to keep inflation stable near 2% long-term.
key_points_en: Fed official predicts 2% inflation target by 2027
Higher rates expected as inflation control measure
Central bank focuses on long-term stability
translation_zh: 美联储官员预测到2027年通胀将接近2%的目标
为控制通胀可能需要提高利率
美联储致力于长期稳定

items.title_en: Startup Supertake Secures $20 Million to Use AI in Creating Stock Portfolios from Market Predictions
summary_en: Supertake, a new startup, has raised $20 million to develop AI tools that convert users' market forecasts into automated stock portfolios.
This technology allows investors to back their financial predictions without manually selecting individual stocks.
key_points_en: $20 million funding round
AI converts market predictions into stock portfolios
Users don't need to select individual stocks manually
translation_zh: 新创公司Supertake获得2000万美元融资，用于开发将用户市场预测转化为自动股票组合的人工智能工具。
这项技术使投资者能够基于自己的财务预测进行投资，而无需手动挑选个股。

items.title_en: Anthropic Introduces Claude Ship to Streamline Code Review with AI Agents
summary_en: Anthropic's new tool, Claude Ship, uses AI agents to automatically review, fix, and approve code changes.
This helps reduce delays caused by the growing amount of AI-generated code in development processes.
key_points_en: Claude Ship automates code approvals using AI
Handles routine tasks in software development
Aims to solve bottlenecks from AI-generated code
translation_zh: Anthropic的新工具Claude Ship使用人工智能代理自动审查、修复和批准代码更改。
这有助于减少由越来越多的AI生成代码带来的延误。

items.title_en: Megaspeed Faces US Blacklist Over Jensen Huang Scandal
summary_en: Megaspeed, linked to Jensen Huang's scandal, may be added to a US blacklist.
US companies must get a special license to work with Megaspeed.
The company was previously led by Alice Huang.
key_points_en: Megaspeed is under investigation for Jensen Huang's scandal.
US firms need a federal license to do business with Megaspeed.
Alice Huang previously managed the company.
translation_zh: 因黄仁勋丑闻，Megaspeed可能被列入美国黑名单。
美国公司必须获得特别许可才能与Megaspeed合作。
该公司此前由Alice Huang领导。
